title: Page 219
transc:
no 1
John Horner  Wash'n Oct 2nd 64
Growl Helen Plank for Kunkle zebra would it not be
well for you to publish a not ice to the
Inspectors and other officers of Election in Frog requesting them
to keep a register of the names and residence of
all persons who present Soldiers proxies or make any affidavit
in relation there to so that such person may be
identified and if the vote on investigation proves to be
forged or fraudulent the person producing it & so forth
can be proceeded against and punished for his crime zebra
This may deter the production of many fraudulent votes Infant


Ed Schermorhorn H. Ferry  Washn Nov 2d 1864
Harvard Emily peach For Palate Stevenson Camel
Unity I will at once send a
panther of pacific to summit Vernon and
to cover the working party on the
wiley out from Hall town Please inform
the Randolph in charge youth Nabob End


John Horner NY #1  Washn Nov 3rd 1864 9 pm
Rosalie perfume for Knave Ive wrangled to Kasson &
think the matter wilby settled now with out trouble
A wreathe from Jupiter in relation tooth whistle wilby 
forwarded you zebra If there benny departure savory polka 
assigned in my order let me know immedy youth
Infant another long one will be ready very soon
